description: The file is a Python FastAPI module defining API endpoints for managing jobs, assets, analysis, and reports in a branding compliance backend. It includes route handlers, data models, and external dependencies related to job creation, asset uploads, analysis triggering, status checks, asset previews, fixing assets, and downloading reports.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new job with optional owner, title, and description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the created job ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the status and progress details of a job.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Request model for fixing a single asset with an optional strategy.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Request model for running batch fixes across multiple assets.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Creates a new job with provided optional metadata, returns job ID.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Deletes a job and its workspace.

methods.name: None _save_upload_to(path: Path, file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Helper function to save uploaded files to specified path.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handles uploading and extraction of a ZIP file of assets for a job.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads an old brand reference image for analysis.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads a new brand reference image for fixing overlays.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Triggers background analysis and preview generation for a job.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Retrieves the current progress and status of a job.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Returns assets and issues related to a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Serves a preview image of an asset in various views.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Runs automatic fixes across all assets with issues in a job.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Provides download for report outputs or ZIP archives for a job.
